delivery_mode: single-maintainer; tests and evidence, not repeated approval boards

tasks.title: Exact citation kernels and independent oracles
acceptance: Run Rust tests against every independent subset-enumeration case, including empty population and u64-overflow totals.
Reject duplicate IDs and missing counts under reject policy.
Keep g capped at N actual works; document differing comparator conventions.

tasks.title: Versioned wire identities and safe missingness
acceptance: Rust and JSON Schema agree on valid/invalid wire fixtures.
Equivalent observation permutations produce identical result bytes; source/scope/method changes invalidate calculation keys.
Permission/style changes do not silently change scientific values; denied output and modified results are rejected.
Use RFC8785/SHA256 dependencies, not handwritten cryptography.

tasks.title: Bounded local JSONL and CLI
acceptance: Run compiled CLI fixtures, including CRLF, no final newline, byte/count limits, malformed JSON and denied exports.
Assert data-only stdout, non-disclosing stderr and documented partial-prefix behaviour.
Demonstrate bounded memory on adversarial oversized frames.

tasks.title: Native build, feature and supply-chain qualification
acceptance: Resolve and commit lockfile in a networked trusted checkout; retain exact tools/targets.
Run fmt, Clippy, tests, doctests and semantic schema parity on Linux/macOS/Windows.
Run cargo-audit/deny and secret scanning with real tool exit codes; no blanket exemptions.
Run property, mutation and parser fuzz tests on changed core; scheduled longer runs use the same corpus.

tasks.title: Independent bibliometric method comparison
acceptance: Pin bibliometrix and PyBibX revisions, environments, licences and method definitions.
Use identical identities, corpus, citation universe, cutoff, missingness and actual-N convention.
Integer outputs must match exactly; unresolved disagreements are reported, never averaged away.
For each of 147 inventoried outcomes, retain explicit unsupported/deferred/qualified state.

tasks.title: Searchright installed producer-consumer slice
acceptance: Use actual bytes from exact Searchright and CiteLattice revisions, not two handwritten lookalike fixtures.
Preserve CSL and source receipts; citation counts arrive in typed evidence sidecars with coverage and permissions.
Test duplicates, conflicting replay, corrections, missing sequence, cancellation and version rejection.
Demonstrate spooled restart and a consistent sink/checkpoint boundary before claiming replay.
Validate canonical digest, decimal counters, strict sequence/prior revision and event ID replay conflicts; keep raw CSL out of serialized state.
Demonstrate durable event spool and exact checkpoint consistency before promoting beyond in-memory single-epoch processing.

tasks.title: Entity-resolution benchmark and downstream error propagation
acceptance: Qualify a pinned S2AND release and rights for each component; isolate author blocks and labels from development.
Report pairwise and cluster metrics, splits/merges, abstention and downstream metric distortion.
Stratify by ambiguity, field, geography/language where legitimate metadata exists; do not infer sensitive traits.

tasks.title: Graph and temporal scientific baselines
acceptance: Validate citation, coauthorship, co-citation and coupling on independent graph fixtures.
Preserve directed/undirected edge semantics, node types, multiedges, self-citation policy and stable dictionary epochs.
Qualify CD_t, sleeping beauty, RPYS/main paths with exact windows and insufficient-reference/citation statuses.

tasks.title: Typed outputs and rendering audit baseline
acceptance: Round-trip Arrow/Parquet types, units, nulls, exact integers, metadata and row identities.
Generate all formats from the same authoritative table; no independent workbook recalculation.
Every quantitative mark resolves to rows or aggregate membership; malformed geometry and hidden restricted payloads are rejected.
Test CSV/XLSX formula injection, SVG/HTML scripts, hover/hidden layers and accessible equivalent tables.

tasks.title: Coverage-aware comparative conclusions
acceptance: Freeze selection rules, missingness mechanisms, baselines, primary endpoint and useful effect threshold before held-out confirmation.
Compare zero-imputation, complete-case and source-naive point metrics against explicit bounds/abstention; retain all failures.
Distinguish missing known counts from missing works, missing edges and erroneous linkage.
Show reduced false directional/rank claims at a prespecified abstention budget, with paired uncertainty and subgroup analyses; otherwise report no gain.
tasks.research_question: Can source- and identity-aware uncertainty prevent misleading comparative conclusions without making the analysis unusably noncommittal?

tasks.title: Incremental research graphs with exact revision semantics
acceptance: Test additions, deletions, corrections, identity merges/splits, rights revocation and out-of-order/conflicting events.
Every integer result must equal full recomputation; floating tolerances are method-specific and frozen.
Crash injection must preserve a consistent durable boundary; denied data cannot survive in stale renders or caches.
Benchmark full recomputation and candidate incremental backends on identical event histories and resource budgets; claim an advance only for held-out workloads showing a prespecified useful gain.
tasks.research_question: Can auditable incremental analytics remain equivalent to full recomputation while reducing latency and resource use under real corrections?

tasks.title: Evidence-linked uncertainty imaging
acceptance: Compare plain static/interactive maps with evidence drill-down, uncertainty layers and temporal alignment using the same data.
Verify mark membership conservation, approximate-layout diagnostics, stable labels, coordinate transforms and static accessibility equivalents.
Inject known denominator, coverage, identity and layout changes; assess detection/interpretation accuracy and time, not attractiveness alone.
Freeze user-study design, minimum useful effect and analysis before recruitment; obtain appropriate approvals when human data are collected.
Use optional GPU/3D only when measured scale or interpretability benefit exceeds complexity and distortion costs.
tasks.research_question: Do traceable, uncertainty-aware scenes improve identification of misleading evidence changes compared with conventional science maps?

tasks.title: Scholarly signals to adoption forecasts and information value
acceptance: Pin Innovate/Voiage and supported methods; pass versioned Arrow/Parquet without copying engines.
Separate publication/effective dates from first-observed dates; use rolling-origin and technology-family-held-out splits.
Compare counts/trends and diffusion baselines against structural/semantic/cross-domain features using independently measured adoption outcomes.
Define alternatives, utilities/net benefit, joint uncertainty, population/horizon and study costs before VOI; citations are not utilities.
Assess prediction calibration and decision regret/ENBS separately; include source rights/cost, negative results and perspective/heterogeneity sensitivity.
tasks.research_question: Do improved scholarly measurements change out-of-time adoption predictions and evidence-investment decisions, rather than merely describing past attention?

tasks.title: Performance and portability evidence
acceptance: Measure wall/CPU time, peak RSS, allocations, cold/warm start and output bytes with hardware/toolchain/thread counts.
Use identical work, input bytes, output requirements and memory caps; include preprocessing and declared exclusions.
Report distributions and uncertainty rather than a cherry-picked best run.
Qualify each optional dependency/feature separately; align Arrow versions before combined backends.

tasks.title: Independent rerun and negative-result archive
acceptance: Freeze data/code/method/render manifests before independent rerun.
Retain hold-out custody, dependency/model checksums and lawful access instructions; no hidden licensed redistribution.
Publish failures, null findings, missing evidence and portability gaps alongside successes.
A coding agent review may inspect implementation, but does not substitute for independent datasets or empirical replication.
Scope each independent rerun to its claimed research result; do not require all four research programmes to finish before one can be evaluated.
tasks.activation: Run per completed research comparison; one research claim does not wait for unrelated research tracks.

tasks.title: Scoped release and claim decision
acceptance: Release only capabilities passing their relevant profile; optional research hypotheses do not block a useful validated core.
Record per-method supported inputs, numerical conventions, limitations and evidence revision.
Do not describe the whole library as beyond-frontier from one successful experiment; name the measured capability, comparator, dataset and scope.
Re-run relevant baselines when substantive methods or dependencies change.
